anomalies.description: A violent clash between riot police in full protective gear (helmets, shields) and protesters, including individuals in yellow vests, on a city street. Police advance and push back the crowd; physical contact, shoving, and use of shields to disperse are evident.

Mutual physical combat occurs between multiple individuals: protesters (including one in a pink beanie) and police officers engage in close-range shoving, grabbing, and defensive/offensive use of shields. The interaction is reciprocal and dynamic, not one-sided.

Police in full riot gear (helmets, shields, body armor) form a tight line confronting a single individual from behind; the posture and formation indicate an active crowd control operation amid unrest.; Large-scale crowd unrest continues with dense gathering of protesters (many in yellow vests), some raising arms, others filming or confronting authorities. Smoke/gas visible in background (e.g., f12–f15), indicating ongoing escalation and dispersal efforts beyond the initial police line.

Large, dense crowd of protesters—many wearing yellow vests—engaged in chaotic close-quarters interaction with law enforcement or counter-protesters; visible smoke/gas in background, people raising arms, shouting, and jostling; consistent with violent group unrest.

A dense crowd of protesters, many wearing yellow vests, is gathered in a street; smoke (likely from flares or tear gas) appears in the background starting around frame f4 (10.0s), and the crowd shows agitation, with some individuals raising arms and holding signs, indicating collective unrest.; A line of riot police in full protective gear (helmets, shields, body armor) forms a barrier facing protesters; a protester kneels or crouches in front of them, suggesting confrontation and escalation of the protest into a standoff.

A chaotic confrontation involving multiple police officers in riot gear and several civilians (including yellow-vested individuals) in a street setting, with physical contact, shielding, and rapid movement indicating collective violent unrest.

A person wearing a pink beanie and purple backpack is surrounded by multiple police officers in riot gear; one officer appears to be grabbing or restraining the individual while others close in, with no visible resistance from the person being restrained.
A man in a yellow high-visibility vest actively pushes or shoves a police officer holding a shield, while the officer braces; this appears to be mutual physical engagement amid the crowd.

A police officer bends down near a detained individual standing beside a police van; the posture suggests possible searching, cuffing, or forceful handling of a subdued person, though the individual’s face and full posture are obscured.

A large group of individuals wearing yellow vests is gathered in a city street intersection, with visible debris and yellow paint splatters on the wet road surface; some individuals appear to be moving dynamically, and the overall scene suggests collective unrest or confrontation, consistent with a riotous situation.
